notes.note: Reviewed the Connections guide App home precedence and narrow Claude proxy troubleshooting against the Engine detail response, the saved-setting clear guard, the credential-profile launch resolver, the Claude SDK result mapper and the chat renderer. Explicit custom home prevents the legacy opt-in and base snapshot import; profile actions retain their own authority. A classified Claude request reports the client-version requirement and points conditionally to the proxy. Focused mounted UI, adapter and route tests cover the changed seams; no live proxy or native evidence.

Reviewed section 1.1 against the shared App home predicate, credential-profile launch resolver, App home route and mounted Advanced controls. The explicit home takes precedence over the base opt-in and leaves the stored legacy profile clearable under the existing server guard. Active-session and non-atomic clear limitations remain documented.

Reviewed the tracked SDK options, configured environment layer precedence, managed environment exclusion and result path. This does not change executable/model selection, home binding, skills, approvals, adoption, readiness or session event delivery. The focused adapter suite exercises start-to-result behavior with an injected SDK result and direct/default controls.
